text: The SEC should re-evaluate its reliance on the Company Act's disclosure regime in its current form as the best means of protecting retail investors from the risks of investing in unconstrained mutual funds.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: Regardless of the SEC's reason for inaction, the authors believe that the SEC should re-evaluate its reliance on the Company Act's disclosure regime in its current form as the best means of protecting retail investors in relation to the risks posed by investing in UMFs.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: SEC policy toward unconstrained mutual funds
